source_text:
Παραϑετέον καὶ τό· Ὃ γὰρ ἐὰν σπείρῃ ἄνθρωπος, τοῦτο καὶ θερίσει· ὅτι ὁ σπείρων εἰς τὴν σάρκα ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς θερίσει φθοράν, ὁ δὲ σπείρων εἰς τὸ πνεῦμα ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος θερίσει ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

καὶ ὁ προφήτης· Οἱ σπείροντες ἐν δάκρυσιν ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει θεριοῦσιν.
pass_a_gloss: And one must set beside also the: For whatever a human may sow, this he will also harvest; that the one sowing into the flesh from the flesh will harvest corruption, but the one sowing into the spirit from the spirit will harvest eternal life. And the prophet: Those sowing in tears will harvest in exultation.
pass_b_english: Set beside it also [[“Whatever a person sows, that he will also reap: the one who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption, but the one who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.” >> Bible:Galatians 6:7-8]]
And the prophet: [[“Those who sow in tears shall reap with shouts of joy.” >> Bible:Psalm 126:5]]
